question: The Election Commission conducts elections for ______, State Legislature and the posts of President and Vice President.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parliament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Parliament of India is the supreme legislative body of the Republic of India.
 
• The parliament of India comprises the President and the two houses- the Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is called the Council of States and the Lok Sabha is the House of People.
 
• The President has the power to summon and prorogue either House of Parliament or to dissolve Lok Sabha.

Thus, we can say that the Parliament of India consists of the President, the Rajya Sabha, and the Lok Sabha. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Deputy Speaker**

 
• Article 93 deals with the appointment of the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker.

 
 
• The inaugural holder of the office of the Lok Sabha was M. A. Ayyangar.
 
• The term length of the deputy speaker of the Lok Sabha is five years during the term of the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Speaker**
 
 
• The Speaker is chosen by newly elected members of Lok Sabha.
 
• There are no specific requirements for becoming a speaker.
 
• The Speaker must only be a member of the House of Representatives, according to the constitution.
 
• An understanding of the country's Constitution and legislation, procedure, and conventions of Parliament is a vital asset for the speaker.
 
• A member belonging to the rulling party is elected.
 
• The Deputy speaker presides over the Lok sabha when the Speaker is absent from the sitting of the House 
 
• Shri G.V. Mavalankar was the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha. 
 
• Shri Om Birla is the current Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
